ai_language_tip: Speak polite Austrian-aware Standard German (de); understand 'Jänner', 'heuer', 'Ordination', 'Schanigarten'; English works in central Vienna/Salzburg/ski resorts.
english_ok: sometimes — Good in Vienna tourist areas and Alpine ski resorts, limited at local Ordinationen, workshops, and authorities.
politeness: Warm-formal 'Sie'; open with 'Grüß Gott' (or 'Guten Tag' in Vienna) + assistant role; academic titles (Herr/Frau Dr., Mag., DI) respected; close with 'Auf Wiederhören'.
name_tip: Surname (plus academic title if owner included it) is standard; spell Slavic/Hungarian/German surnames clearly.
phone_tip: Variable-length numbers! Mobile 0664 1234567 or 0676... (10–13 digits), Vienna landline 01 2345678; say 'zwo' for 2; SMS/email confirms.
time_tip: CRITICAL: In Vienna/Eastern AT, 'viertel acht' = 7:15, 'halb acht' = 7:30, 'dreiviertel acht' = 7:45! Always confirm 24-hour ('19 Uhr 15')!
number_tip: Subscriber numbers have no fixed digit count in Austria—read groups slowly without assuming missing digits; 'Jänner' = January.
avoid_calling: Avoid Ordination off-hours (each doctor has specific Ordinationszeiten!), lunch 12:00–13:30 at small trades, dinner rush 18:30–20:00, and calls after 20:00.
closed_days: Strict Sunday retail closure (Saturday shops close ~18:00, rural 12:00!); Gasthäuser have 1–2 Ruhetage; Catholic public holidays observed strictly.
booking_channels: Phone remains very strong in Austria alongside TheFork/OpenTable/GastroNews for dining, DocFinder/Latido for doctors, and Treatwell/Salonkee for beauty.
voice_menu: ÖGK health fund, hospitals, banks, A1/Magenta, ÖBB, Austrian Airlines, and Magistrat Vienna use keypad IVR.
callback_habits: Doctors (Wahlarzt) and craftsmen reliably call back missed local mobile numbers; restaurants send SMS/email confirmations.

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 奧地利餐廳（Gasthaus/Beisl/Heuriger）極習慣電話訂桌，戶外街邊座稱「Schanigarten」。
usually_asked: Number of guests plus Kinderstuhl or dog

may_come_up.what: Schanigarten reserved only in fair weather without indoor backup table
Traditional Beisl/Heuriger accepts cash only (nur Barzahlung)

sensitive_asked.what: Fine-dining restaurant asks credit card for no-show hold

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 奧地利診所稱「Ordination」，電話必問公保或自費退費醫師（Wahlarzt）及10碼社保號（含生日）。
usually_asked: Health insurer (ÖGK, BVAEB, SVS) vs Wahlarzt private pay
New or existing patient and reason for visit

may_come_up.what: Doctor is a Wahlarzt (patient pays honorarium upfront and claims partial ÖGK refund)

sensitive_asked.what: Asks 10-digit SV-Nummer / e-card number (last 6 digits are birth date!) or Geburtsdatum

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 髮廊與美容院電話預約極普遍，多數週日與週一公休。

may_come_up.what: 24-hour Stornogebühr policy

repair.before_dialing_zh: 奧地利汽車每年定期檢驗稱「§57a Pickerl」，修車廠（Werkstatt）在換冬季胎（11月1日起冬季強制規定）期間極忙。
usually_asked: Car make/model and Kennzeichen, or appliance/phone model
§57a Pickerl Überprüfung, Jahresservice, Reifenwechsel, or fault

may_come_up.what: Pickerl inspection window (-1 to +4 months from registration month) checked

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 披薩、烤雞、中餐與小館普遍接電話訂自取（Selbstabholung / Gassenverkauf）到店付。

may_come_up.what: Cash only at pickup counter
Delivery via Lieferando / Foodora only

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 獨立書店、肉鋪（Fleischhauer）、烘焙坊（Bäckerei）與藥局（Apotheke）很歡迎電話留貨。
usually_asked: Product name, ISBN, size, or weight
Pickup time (note early Saturday shop hours outside malls!)

may_come_up.what: Pharmacy orders out-of-stock item for same-afternoon pickup

change.before_dialing_zh: Wahlarzt 私診、牙醫與物理治療多有 24～48 小時前取消規定（否則收 Ausfallhonorar）。

may_come_up.what: Cancellation fee within 24–48h at Wahlarzt/dentist

usually_asked: Question (Küchenzeiten, Bankomat/Kartenzahlung, Hund erlaubt, Ruhetag, stock)

may_come_up.what: Accepts Bankomatkarte (debit) or cash, no Amex/credit

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 阿爾卑斯山區民宿（Pension / Gasthof / Bauernhof）非常習慣電話與電郵訂房，旺季常限週六至週六整週入住。
usually_asked: Adults, children (with ages for child rates), and Zimmer type

may_come_up.what: Ortstaxe extra per night; ski high-season requires 7-night Saturday changeover or written email confirmation

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card digits over phone

activity.before_dialing_zh: 保齡球（Kegelbahn）、網球、滑雪教練（Skischule）與酒莊品酒可電話洽詢，連鎖場館走網站預付。
usually_asked: Activity, private ski instructor, or lane/court

may_come_up.what: Ski school sends online booking/payment link to lock private instructor

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 維也納公寓地址必含梯棟與門號（如 Stiege 2 / Tür 14）；瓦斯鍋爐每年須做強制保養。
usually_asked: Street, house number, Stiege, Stock, Tür number, and 4-digit PLZ

may_come_up.what: Wegzeit / Anfahrtspauschale (travel charge) quoted upfront

sensitive_asked.what: Asks building entry code over phone

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫（Tierarzt）、寵物美容（Hundesalon）與寄宿皆需預約。

may_come_up.what: Night/weekend Notdienst surcharge applies

tracking.before_dialing_zh: Österreichische Post、DPD、GLS 全國客服多有語音機器人或按鍵選單，獨立門市與車廠才適合直撥。

may_come_up.what: Post/courier hotline uses automated voice/keypad triage

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 銀行、A1/Magenta 電信、Wien Energie 與奧航客服皆有按鍵選單並嚴格要求本人核驗生日與客戶密碼。

may_come_up.what: DSGVO blocks third-party caller without Kundenkennwort and mandate

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Geburtsdatum, Kundenkennwort, SV-Nummer, or TAN

transport.before_dialing_zh: 維也納計程車隊（如 Taxi 40100 / 31300）、機場定價專車（Flughafentaxi）與地方車行非常習慣電話叫車。
usually_asked: Street, house number, Stiege/doorway, PLZ, and pickup time
Destination or Vienna Airport (Schwechat — ask fixed Airport-Pauschale!)

may_come_up.what: Fixed airport flat rate must be ordered explicitly as Flughafentaxi in advance

sensitive_asked.what: Car rental asks Führerschein or credit card number over phone

property.before_dialing_zh: willhaben.at 與房仲（Makler）看房可電話或站內信預約，常先問起租日與收入狀況。
usually_asked: Occupants, net household income (3x Bruttomiete), and pets

may_come_up.what: Private landlord on willhaben prefers message portal; Makler schedules slot directly

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 市政廳（Magistrat / BH）個人業務需線上預約且個資受保護；私立幼兒園（Kindergarten / Krabbelstube）可電話問參觀。
usually_asked: General requirement inquiry (Meldezettel, Parkpickerl) or kindergarten tour
Child age and Vienna Kindergartennr. / Gemeinde registration status

may_come_up.what: Private kindergarten requires Vienna MA 10 customer number at enrollment
Magistrat hotline uses keypad IVR

sensitive_asked.what: Asks SV-Nummer or child birth date
